# Taipei GTA

Taipei GTA (臺北狂飆) is a browser game and guide site about exploring a stylized Taipei city. The site includes a playable game at /play/, plus guides for controls, missions, maps, vehicles and landmarks.

Core answers:
- Play URL: https://taipeigta.io/play/
- Contact: help@taipeigta.io
- Core topic: taipei gta
- Game type: browser-based single-player open-world experience
- Main locations: Taipei 101, Ximending, Elephant Mountain and Taipei streets
